_readme: Services as provided in the original site and source-assets/notes (now archived). Descriptions are client input: replace a [[NEEDS_CLIENT]] marker with 1-2 sentences to show it on the live site. Descriptions written as drafts for client review get "draft": true inside the description object (e.g. {"ar": "...", "en": "...", "draft": true}); the flag has no visible effect, the build lists them so they can be found for review. A service with "image" (an images.json key) and "imageAlt" is shown as a photo card in the first row of the home services section; the photo shows the type of work only, never a project.
